integrity: All mathematical claims in the finding are proved in RESULT.md; finite computation is reported only as corroboration. Known path, cycle, hypercube, and complete-bipartite boundary cases are identified as prior coverage rather than presented as independently new evaluations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to complete bipartite graphs with a matching deleted, not to arbitrary edge-deletion patterns.
Finite enumeration is corroborative only; the all-parameter claim rests on the symbolic forcing argument.
A poorly indexed equivalent result under substantially different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Dom-forcing under matching deletions in complete bipartite graphs
